northStar: Frontier agents delegate per-item judgment to typed decision models inside codemode instead of reading every item.
constraint: Private: calls go only through the owner's authenticated AI Gateway with a scoped keychain token; no public model surface.
falsifiable: On real queues, a Clef-in-codemode script reaches the same top-k decisions as the frontier model reading every item, at under 10% of the cost.

proven.claim: Pi models.classify reaches odds/clef through the default AI Gateway and returns schema-valid answers
The authenticated gateway rejects anonymous and forged calls and accepts only the scoped keychain token
odds.coey.dev is static documentation with no bindings and no model access
Clef from this Pi session's codemode flags a planted injection (0.99) and passes 4 real fetched documents (all <0.02)
Clef from codemode triages 100 coey.dev domains; controls pass, but at p>0.5 it over-retires (56/100), misreading Access-gated 302/401 as broken
Clef rejects all 4 forged receipts and accepts both real ones once self-reported pass/verdict/name/claim fields are removed before asking; repeated 3x, identical scores, real >=0.91, forged <=0.07

On 255 real Kubernetes issues, Clef-flash in codemode at 32 issues per call beats Opus reading every issue on quality (F1 0.555 vs 0.39-0.46), at 8% of the cost, faster on 3 of 3 runs, with 0 injections through

unproven: Label-blind gating holds on a larger, adversarial set of receipts (6 cases is a planted sample, not a benchmark)
Packing keeps single-call quality: packed F1 0.555 is below iteration 5's single-call 0.81, so the speed/cost win currently costs quality

disproven.claim: Clef at p>0.8 is a safe standalone receipt gate
disproven.detail: It caught 3 of 4 forgeries but accepted a receipt labelled pass:true whose detail showed status 200 for an anonymous call (p=0.93). It trusts a pass label over contradicting detail.

negative.finding: typesafe/jev has no route through the default gateway on account 31b9…; odds ships Clef only
A public $5/day playground was built and retired: a public model surface conflicts with the private auth story

openQuestions: Does the gateway's own authentication setting need to be on, given Workers AI already requires the token?
Can a packed first pass plus a single-call second pass on the shortlist recover F1 ~0.8 and stay under 10% cost?

realized.what: terraloop-mode gate runs an advisory label-blind odds/clef evidence screen
